pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: full-depth main hip along the house axis, ridge near the centre line, hipped both ends; NW face dark. Parallel diagonal bands and bright fascia lines inside the roof read as a 2-story section casting shadows on 1-story roofs around it

pieces.name: front_left
pieces.notes: front (SE) cross hip on the W half, ridge perpendicular to main, big lit SE and SW faces; valleys run near 35 deg so its pitch likely differs from main

pieces.name: cross_right
pieces.notes: cross hip through the E half from the NW eave to the SE eave, ridge perpendicular to main, hipped at both eaves; lit SE face, dark 45 deg band is a hip edge plus its shadow

exclude_notes: wood pergola/deck strip along the SE eave of the E half
notes: House rotated 26 deg. Full-depth main hip plus a front-left cross hip and a right cross hip. Two long parallel diagonal lines cross the middle that equal-pitch hips do not explain; LiDAR should set pitches. The back-left may be a 2-story block with its own eave (bright fascia lines inside the roof). Confidence medium-low.
